snippet.title: Lost RETROGRADE | Forest Trailer
snippet.description:
Lost RETROGRADE is a stealth action game about finding your missing grandfather, while avoiding a mysterious man that learns from & adapts to your every move. 

Wishlist the game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1380190/Lost_RETROGRADE/

Application for Epic Games' MegaGrant program.

Trailer song: Fuzzeke And Josh Huxley - Pulse Terror

#lostretrograde #indiegame #horrorgame #lore
